exposure: Sequential singleton pregnancies conceived by IVF
cohort: 63 primiparous women aged ≤ 38 years who conceived by IVF and delivered sequential singletons or twins at a single tertiary university affiliated medical center between 2011 and 2019.
finding: Sequential singleton pregnancies in primiparous women of advanced maternal age conceived via IVF had overall good outcomes, with no significant differences between the first and second pregnancies, and were associated with better outcomes compared to twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with twin pregnancies had significantly higher cesarean delivery rates compared to women with two singleton deliveries.
